verse.verse_1: NUN. I CALL to witness the pen and what they inscribe,
verse.verse_2: You are not demented by the grace of your Lord.
verse.verse_3: There is surely reward unending for you,
verse.verse_4: For you are verily born of sublime nature.
verse.verse_5: So you will see, and they will realise,
verse.verse_7: Verily your Lord knows those who have gone astray from His path, and He knows those who are guided on the way.
verse.verse_8: So do not comply with those who deny:
verse.verse_9: They only want that you should relent, so that they may come to terms.
verse.verse_10: Do not heed a contemptible swearer,
verse.verse_12: Who hinders men from (doing) good, the transgressor, the iniquitous,
verse.verse_13: Crude, and above all, mean and infamous,
verse.verse_14: Simply because he possesses wealth and children.
verse.verse_15: When you recite Our revelations to him, he says: "These are fables of long ago."
verse.verse_16: We shall brand him on the muzzle.
verse.verse_17: We have tried you as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed to gather the fruits in the morning
verse.verse_18: But did not add: "If God may please."
verse.verse_19: Then a calamity from your Lord fell upon it, but they remained fast asleep.
verse.verse_20: So by the morning it seemed as though picked clean.
verse.verse_21: At daybreak they called to each other:
verse.verse_22: "If you want to gather the fruits, let us go early to the plantation."
verse.verse_23: So they departed, talking in low voices:
verse.verse_24: "Let no needy person come to you within it today."
verse.verse_25: They left early in the morning bent on this purpose.
verse.verse_26: When they saw (and did not recognise it) they said: "Surely we have lost the way.
verse.verse_27: No. In fact we have been deprived of it."
verse.verse_28: One who was temperate among them, said: "Did I not say: 'Why don't you priase God?'"
verse.verse_29: "Glory to our Lord," they said; we were really in the wrong."
verse.verse_30: Then they started blaming one another,
verse.verse_31: Saying: "Alas the woe, we were iniquitous.
verse.verse_32: Maybe our Lord will give us better than this. We turn to our Lord in supplication."
verse.verse_33: Such is Our chastisement; and the punishment of the Hereafter will be greater, if only they knew!
verse.verse_34: For those who fear God there are pleasure gardens with their Lord.
verse.verse_35: Should We treat those who submit and obey in the same way as those who are culpable?
verse.verse_36: What has come upon you that you judge in such a wise?
verse.verse_37: Or have you a Book in which you read
verse.verse_38: That you can surely have whatever you choose?
verse.verse_39: Or have you taken a binding promise from Us which would hold till the Day of Judgement, that you will get whatever you demand?
verse.verse_40: Ask them: "Which of you is able to vouch for this?"
verse.verse_41: Or have they any partners? Let them bring their partners then, if what they say is true.
verse.verse_42: On the day the great calamity befalls, and they are called to bow in homage, they will not be able to do so.
verse.verse_43: Lowered will be their eyes, disgrace overwhelming them. They had indeed been called to bow in homage when they were free of blame.
verse.verse_44: So leave those who deny this Discourse to Me. We shall lead them step by step to (ruin) in a way they will not know.
verse.verse_45: Yet I will give them respite: Surely My plan is compact.
verse.verse_46: Do you ask for any compensation from them that they are burdened with want?
verse.verse_47: Or do they have knowledge of the unknown which they copy down?
verse.verse_48: So wait with patience for the judgement of your Lord, and do not be like (onah) of the fish who called (to his Lord) when he was choked with anger.
verse.verse_49: Had it not been for a favour from his Lord he would have been cast blame-worthy on a barren plain.
verse.verse_50: Then his Lord chose him and placed him among the upright.
verse.verse_51: But the unbelievers would like to stare you out of balance when they hear the warning, and say: "Surely he is possessed;"
verse.verse_52: Whilst it is no more than reminder for the people of the world.
